Name: Abigail without bow
Author: CoffeeBuns
Description:
It bothered me that Abigail has a bow on her sprite but not in her portrait. And honestly I never felt like the bow seemed in character. So here she is without the bow!

1.2 There are now [s]three[/s] four versions.[b] Her everyday outfit is the same in every one. She does not have a bow.[/b] The difference is in her "fancier" outfits. The dress for the dance and her wedding dress. I know these are not that big a deal but I wanted to provide options! :]
Look at the pictures above for details.

1) Version 1 she has the original bows
2) Version 2 she has no bows at all(the bow never even existed!)
3) Version 3 she has some alternate head accessories.
4) Version 4 same as 3 just with a different headband

I also just changed the shape of her hair on some of sprites where it looked odd with out the bow. I did this originally but I missed some or just didn't do it enough.

Installation:
Put in your characters folder. By default it is:

C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Characters

Back up the original Abigail.xnb
